messages:
Hiro: Quick bulletin  year-end purchase freeze window and a small change to vendor exceptions. Please skim. :bell:

Hiro: 1) Annual purchase freeze: all non-essential purchases will be locked from 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03. 2) Emergency procurement path: tag @finance with EMERG and include business justification + expected cost.

Mel: What qualifies as "non-essential"? Is renewal of annual licensing considered essential?

Hiro: Renewals that are contractually obligated or that will cause service disruption if missed are essential. For clarity: add "contractual renewal" note in the vendor form and we'll fast-track approvals.

Darya: Small tweak to exceptions: director-level signoff now applies for single transactions between $5k-$50k; FP&A approval required for >$50k. This replaces the old $25k cap.

Mel: That's a noticeable bump. Any reason for the change?

Hiro: It's to reduce backlog and speed up product teams during Q4 planning; budget owners still need to confirm funds. We monitored ticket times and adjusted thresholds.

FinanceBot: Auto-notice: Exception request created by OpsLead at 1799123499. ID: EXC-2026-078. Status: pending director signoff.

OpsLead: FYI I submitted an exception for a data provider renewal. I included contract and renewal date in the form.

Darya: Thanks OpsLead  that'll help. Reminder: if the vendor handles PII, security must attach a completed questionnaire before legal signs.

Mel: During the freeze window, can teams open vendor forms so they queue up, or will forms be rejected?

Hiro: Forms can be submitted anytime but procurement will only approve critical/contractual items during the freeze. Non-critical approvals will queue and be processed after 2027-01-03.

FinanceBot: Automated reminder  please reconcile any outstanding corporate card charges before 2026-12-18 to avoid hold during the freeze. (sent at 1799123505)

OpsLead: Noted. Can you publish a one-line summary for managers to share in their teams? I'll put it on the weekly manager digest.

Hiro: Will do. I'll post a 3-bullet manager summary + FAQ link by EOD today. Link: <https://redwood.internal/finance/year-end-freeze|year-end freeze FAQ>.

Mel: Thanks. Also - does this affect prepay card pilot? Some teams need month-end spend.

Hiro: Prepay cards can be used for emergency/essential purchases during freeze, but teams must attach justification and expect post-hoc audit. Pilot rules still apply.

Darya: Last note: any vendor exception decisions made before 2026-12-20 will be honored during the freeze if procurement includes the approval memo in the vendor record.

Hiro: Appreciate everyone's quick read. Ping @finance or DM me for edge cases. :wave:
